player_prompt.intro: Welcome to Lights Out! Ị nwere {size}x{size} grid nke ọkụ. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ gị bụ ịgbanye ọkụ niile (nke a na-anọchite anya '.') Mgbe ị na-agbanye ọkụ, ọ na-agbanye onwe ya NA ndị agbata obi ya (elu / ala / aka ekpe / aka nri). Pịnye [row col] iji pịa ọkụ (0-indexed, ya mere, ebe dị irè bụ 0-{max_index}). Ị nwere ruo {max_turns} na-aga iji dozie mgbaghoju anya. Akụkọ ifo: 'O' = ọkụ ON, '.' = ọkụ Gbanyụọ

board.current_state: Ọnọdụ grid ugbu a (Move {moves_made}, {moves_left} na-agagharị agagharị, {completion}% zuru ezu): {grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ihe omume ga-adị na usoro [row col] ebe ahịrị na col bụ integers si 0 ruo {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Ekele! Ị doziri mgbaghoju anya na {moves_used} na-agagharị!
outcome.loss: Egwuregwu agwụla! I jirila {max_turns} niile mee ihe n'emeghị ka mgbaghoju anya ahụ. Mmezu ikpeazụ: {completion}% Ọnọdụ ikpeazụ: {grid}
